note: Tier -> AI entitlement mapping (tracker 337 N-A7). DATA, not code: the Go source never names a tier. Every tier keeps every AI capability here: the commercial line for AI is the iris_model licence add-on (owner 2026-11-12/13; Enterprise includes it), which gates ai.model and ai.investigate as a separate input, together with the platform administrator's console-only switches IRIS_AI_MODELS / IRIS_AI_INVESTIGATIONS. Evidence-only Iris (ai.chat, ai.nlquery without a model) is free in every tier. ai.runbook.author gates tenant runbooks (N-F2); ai.mcp is listed so it is placed when its feature lands and gates nothing yet.
